# MyFilipinoMatch

> MyFilipinoMatch is a dating platform connecting foreigners with Filipino singles for serious, long-term relationships. Verified profiles, secure messaging, video calls, and trust-and-safety tools help members build genuine connections.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of MyFilipinoMatch and how it works.
- [About](/about): Our mission, story, and approach to meaningful matchmaking.
- [Premium](/premium): Subscription plans, pricing, and premium benefits.
- [Safety](/safety): Trust and safety guidelines for members.
- [Support](/support): Help center and contact options.
- [Blog](/blog): Dating advice, success stories, and cultural insights.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling practices.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy): How we use cookies and tracking.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to your account.
- [Sign Up](/signup): Create a new MyFilipinoMatch account.
